description:
Publish a short-text note (kind:1) to Nostr relays. Optionally include hashtag tags and specify target relays. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

relays.description: Relay URLs to publish to. Defaults to wss://relay.damus.io, wss://nos.lol.

tags.description: Comma-separated hashtags to include (e.g., 'bitcoin,nostr,aibtc'). Do not include the '#' prefix.

name: nostr_post
